desc: Ideate and select the depth-wise feasibility plus binary search approach.
Implement trie insertion with pass counts, depths, and per-word path node lists.
Aggregate per-depth max count, number of count-k groups, and unique count-k node.
Implement per-index feasibility check and binary search for the longest valid prefix length.
Handle early return when removing one word leaves fewer than k strings, k=1, duplicates, and short words.
Run sample tests and edge cases; if failures occur, fix the current approach or switch to Euler-tour DSU/trie DP fallback.
